interface.signature: def longestSubstring(s: str, k: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The string s must consist of lowercase letters only.
The input k must be an integer.
The integer k must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: The return value must be an integer.
The return value must be between 0 and the length of the string s, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(s.count(c) >= k for c in set(s) if s.count(c) >= k)
postconditions.description: Every character in the longest substring must appear at least k times.
